image_description: A close-up portrait of a Great White Pelican (or similar species) in profile, facing left. The bird features a long, pale pinkish-orange bill with a visible gular pouch, a white head with a shaggy crest, and a long, curved neck. The background consists of blurred water and dark rocks, with a second pelican partially visible in the background on the right.
